errorCodes.meaning: The community has badges turned off (VTI-BDG-004). Nothing was recorded.
`badgeId` names a community badge. Those are given by the badge's owners with vtc/badges/awards/offer, never here.
`to` is the signer's own entry (VTI-BDG-040). Nothing was recorded.
The signer's membership is younger than the community's `limits.minTenureDays` (VTI-BDG-040). `details.eligibleFrom` says when they may give.

A limit of VTI-BDG-040 is reached: `details.limit` is `kudosPerGiverPerDay` (the signer has given today as many kudos as the community allows) or `sameGiverSameMember` (the signer gave `to` a kudos badge within the bound). `details.until` says when the bound lifts. Nothing was recorded.

Award.description: One giving of a badge to one member. `givenBy` is the giver's directory entry, absent for an award a dynamic badge group's rule made. `note` is shown to the recipient, the giver, the badge's owners and administrators, never to other members. `credentialId` is present on an accepted award of a community badge: the badge credential that evidences it, renewed or re-issued as the badge's regime requires.

decidedAt.description: When the recipient accepted or declined, the giver withdrew, the offer expired, or the award was revoked.

expiresAt.description: When an unanswered offer lapses, where the community expires offers.

Award.title: Award

AwardId.description: Opaque identifier of one giving of a badge to one member: `awd_` followed by 16 to 64 base64url characters. Random and unique within the community.
AwardId.title: AwardId

AwardNote.description: What the award is for, from the giver, shown to the recipient and written as the award's evidence narrative where the badge carries a credential. Plain text; erased with its author (VTI-BDG-090).
AwardNote.title: AwardNote

AwardState.description: `offered`: waiting for the recipient. `accepted`: the recipient took it; for a community badge the credential was issued and the membership recorded. `declined`: the recipient declined; nothing was recorded in the group and nothing issued. `withdrawn`: the giver withdrew the offer before a decision. `expired`: the offer lapsed unanswered. `revoked`: taken back after acceptance (VTI-BDG-023).
AwardState.title: AwardState

BadgeId.description: Opaque identifier of a badge: `bdg_` followed by 16 to 64 base64url characters. Random, community-scoped, never reused (VTI-BDG-001).
BadgeId.title: BadgeId

EntryId.description: Opaque identifier of one directory entry: `dir_` followed by 16 to 64 base64url characters. Random, scoped to one community, and stable for the life of the membership — it survives a rotation of the member's DID, which is why groups, notes and cards are keyed by it. It MUST NOT be derived from, and MUST NOT reveal, any DID of the member, and the same person's entries in two communities MUST NOT share one. Compared by exact string equality.
EntryId.title: EntryId

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

GroupCredentialId.description: Identifier (`id`) of a group membership credential issued to a member. Each renewal issues a new credential with a new identifier. Validity is the community's setting; a community SHOULD default to 30 days, renewed when 10 days remain.
GroupCredentialId.title: GroupCredentialId

Response.description: The success response to a vtc/badges/kudos/give/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/badges/kudos/give/0.1#response.

award.description: The giving, in state `offered`, with `givenBy` the signer and `expiresAt` where the community expires offers. Never a `credentialId`: a kudos badge carries no credential.

schema.description: Give a kudos badge to another member: records an award offered to them, with the giver and a note, within the community's limits. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

badgeId.description: An active kudos badge the signer may see. A community badge is refused: its owners give it with vtc/badges/awards/offer.

note.description: What it is for. Shown to the recipient, the giver and badge administrators; never audited.

to.description: The recipient: an active member whose card the directory shows the signer, never the signer themselves.
